audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Singed levels 2 and 3 while the whys directly under it say 'Level 2 is his' and 'Level 3 evens out'. The page disagrees with itself.
audit.why: The Darkin Glaive's recast knockup lands at level 2 with no Mega Adhesive to answer it, and level 3 is genuinely even once the goo grounds Aureate Rush. The packet chart already matches the prose.
audit.corrected: Skill / Zaahen / Skill / Skill / Skill / Singed / Singed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one Zaahen ability is named anywhere on the page. Every spike, want, why, phase and report row says 'his combo', 'Q-E all-in', 'his power spike' or 'Ultimate'. The full layer literally tracks an ability called 'Ultimate'.
audit.why: Zaahen is new, which is exactly when a player needs the real names and numbers rather than placeholders. 'Track Ultimate' is not a spike a player can watch for.
audit.corrected: Zaahen spikes: level 2 (The Darkin Glaive, 10/9/8/7/6s, double slash + heal, recast for a knockup), Dreaded Return at 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s, Aureate Rush at 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s, Grim Deliverance at 6 (110/95/80s), and Cultivation of War's revive whenever Determination is full. Singed: level 3 grounding, first item, and Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every interaction in this matchup was absent. Nothing about grounding, nothing about the pull, nothing about anti-heal, nothing about the revive.
audit.why: This is the matchup Singed's kit is built for and none of it reached the page. A reader gets 'run away' with no mention of the one ability that stops running.
audit.corrected: Mega Adhesive grounds Aureate Rush — his only dash, and both his entry and his exit, down 10s at rank 1. Dreaded Return is the counter to Singed's whole pattern: an 850-range stab that pulls you back, on 14s. Insanity Potion applies Grievous Wounds through Poison Trail and cuts both of his heals — The Darkin Glaive and Grim Deliverance. Aureate Rush deals percent-health damage, so raw HP stacking is the wrong answer. Cultivation of War lets him revive when Determination is full, so a 'confirmed' kill is not confirmed. Both sides carry displacement — your Fling versus his Glaive recast knockup and Dreaded Return pull — and whoever lands it first owns the trade.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flagged 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' and it was accurate — the page contains no number of any kind.
audit.why: Without numbers there is no sequencing, and this matchup turns entirely on one 14-second cooldown.
audit.corrected: Dreaded Return 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s is the clock. It barely shortens with ranks, so the punish window stays roughly the same size all lane: once he stabs and misses, you have the full 14 seconds to run the pattern. Aureate Rush 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s. Grim Deliverance 110/95/80s.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal guidance despite two healing abilities and a healing passive stack mechanic.
audit.why: Grievous Wounds is unusually strong here and Singed applies it for free through Poison Trail once Insanity Potion is up.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal early is core: Aureate Rush's percent-health damage means armour and HP both underperform, so buy Oblivion Orb over a raw stat and let Insanity Potion do the rest.

notes: This page had no ability names and no numbers at all — the full layer tracked a placeholder called 'Ultimate' in tldr, winCon, enemyWin, dosFull[0], breakdown.cooldowns, report[5] and focus. I fixed all of those to Dreaded Return except focus.text ('Zaahen Ultimate', 15 chars) and focus.letters (['R']), which are both under the applier's 25-character skip threshold; focus should become Dreaded Return / ['W'] and needs a hand edit or a targeted tool pass. Zaahen's kit file gives Dreaded Return (W) a 'knockup' flag while Riot's description says only that it pulls enemies toward him — I wrote 'pull', not 'knockup', per the trust-the-description rule. Same for Q's range of 25000, which is a self-buff placeholder, not a real cast range, so I quoted no range for it.
